events.title: Samsung Galaxy S23 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S23 — Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 globally — refined efficiency-focused flagship.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained [Android]'s volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Snapdragon 8 gen 2 globally — refined efficiency-focused flagship. Developers testing [Android] builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-[Pixel] reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S23 continued Samsung's annual [Android] flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of [Android] users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: [Android] needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.
